methodology.confirmedDefinition: Visit expressly reported by Alex. Starred count requires a named restaurant and a Michelin star in the guide edition applicable to the visit.
methodology.guideVsStar: Michelin Selected, Bib Gourmand, Green Star and Michelin Stars are separate distinctions; Michelin Selected is not a Michelin star.
methodology.editionCaveat: Guide-edition dates do not necessarily align with the calendar year of a meal. Confirm exact visit dates before assigning historical stars.
methodology.unreconciled: Unknown restaurant or unverified date is not counted as a confirmed starred restaurant.

excludedResearch.explanation: Michelin did not publish any US restaurant guide until 2005. No Wisconsin Dells restaurant could hold a US Michelin star in the late 1990s.
